name: Eric Nam
bio: Eric Nam is an American singer, songwriter, and television personality based in South Korea. Since his debut in 2013, he was named GQ Korea's Man of the Year in 2016, included on Forbes' 30 Under 30 Asia in 2017, and named as one of YouTube Music's Global Trending Artists on the Rise in 2019.

credits.title: Loser
credits.overview: Alice, a brilliant but troubled physics star, invents a time machine with her best friend, Benji. But in doing so, they unleash forces far worse than they could have imagined, raising the question: just because you can, does it mean you should?

credits.title: K-POP: The Debut
credits.overview: Lizzy Lee, a young Korean-American woman, has spent her life following the path her family chose for her, but when she earns a spot in a globally televised competition to form the next K-pop girl group, she travels to Seoul, South Korea, to pursue the dream she must still keep hidden.

credits.title: Transplant
credits.overview: A motivated surgical resident pushes himself to extreme lengths while training under a legendary heart transplant surgeon who's obsessed with protecting his perfect reputation.

credits.title: Avatar Aang: The Last Airbender
credits.overview: Avatar Aang, the world's last Airbender, learns of an ancient power that could save his culture from extinction. With the help of his friends, he embarks on a global quest to find it before it falls into the wrong hands and threatens to upend the peace they sacrificed everything to achieve.

credits.title: The 23rd Annual Unforgettable Awards
credits.overview: Annual Awards Show Celebrating API Excellent in Entertainment and Culture

credits.title: First Love Showed Up One Day
credits.overview: A story about a disturbance between a famous composer and a woman suffering from amnesia that coincidently happens after they start to live together, and memories about first love.
